scripts.test:headless: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/desktop test:headless && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/desktop test:runtime && cargo test -p kintsugi --no-default-features --features headless -j ${VOLLI_CONCURRENCY_HINT:-1}
scripts.test: node --test scripts/lint-copy.test.mjs && pnpm lint:copy && cargo test --workspace -j ${VOLLI_CONCURRENCY_HINT:-1} && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/core test && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/editor test && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/ui test && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/desktop test:references && pnpm --filter @kintsugi/desktop test
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
